Notifica di rischio

Questions and answers

What is Notifica di rischio?

In this glossary, Notifica di rischio refers to: A formal alert generated to inform stakeholders of emerging or realized PKI or cryptographic risks, often automated within governance platforms.

How is Notifica di rischio used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Le notifiche di rischio vengono inviate automaticamente agli amministratori PKI quando vengono rilevate vulnerabilità critiche o configurazioni errate."

Definition

A formal alert generated to inform stakeholders of emerging or realized PKI or cryptographic risks, often automated within governance platforms.

Operational example

Risk notifications are automatically sent to PKI administrators when critical vulnerabilities or misconfigurations are detected.

Localized term

Notifica di rischio

Localized example

Le notifiche di rischio vengono inviate automaticamente agli amministratori PKI quando vengono rilevate vulnerabilità critiche o configurazioni errate.
